name: Hotel des Arts Saigon - MGallery Collection
short_description: A 168-room Art Deco-inspired boutique hotel in District 3, with a rooftop infinity pool offering a 270-degree city view and a Sky Lounge for elite members.
ai_summary: Hotel des Arts Saigon - MGallery Collection blends modern Vietnamese, French colonial, and traditional feng shui influences across 168 rooms, functioning as much like an art gallery as a hotel with antique-filled nooks throughout. The rooftop infinity pool offers a 270-degree view over Ho Chi Minh City, and the Sky Lounge provides three daily food and drink services complimentary to executive guests and Platinum-and-above ALL elite members. Guests consistently praise the impressive housekeeping, breakfast quality, and Sky Lounge perks, though the compact 30-square-metre standard executive rooms and curtain-only bathroom separation are recurring watchouts, and it ranks among the pricier Accor properties in the city.

faqs.question: Does Hotel des Arts Saigon have a rooftop pool?
faqs.answer: Yes -- the rooftop infinity pool offers a 270-degree view over Ho Chi Minh City, one of the property's most consistently praised features alongside its Art Deco-inspired design.

faqs.question: Are rooms spacious at Hotel des Arts Saigon?
faqs.answer: Not especially -- the standard Sky Executive Grand Deluxe room runs about 30 square metres, which some guests find compact for a luxury MGallery property, though the design and amenities draw strong praise regardless.
